kael.选择: The seven flames answer to me. Let's burn bright.
kael.开战: Time to show them what real fire looks like!
kael.技能: INFERNO DESCENDS! Witness the apocalypse of fire!
kael.大招: Hah! Is that all you've got?
kael.受伤: The flames never lie. And they say we won.
kael.胜利: The fire... it's going out... I can't...
kael.入狱: You know, controlling seven types of flame simultaneously is actually a great party trick.

lyra.选择: My melody shall freeze their hearts... literally.
lyra.开战: Shall we begin? The audience is waiting.
lyra.技能: Listen closely... this is your lullaby.
lyra.大招: Eternal winter movement! Let the final note echo forever!
lyra.胜利: A standing ovation would be nice, but victory will do.
lyra.闲聊: Do you think ice crystals have a favorite musical key? I think it's D minor.

zephyr.选择: Rune circuits online. Ready to shock the system.
zephyr.开战: Let me draw a little something on the battlefield.
zephyr.技能: THUNDER PRISON! No escape from ten thousand volts!
zephyr.受伤: Another system successfully hacked. With lightning.

nova.选择: Nanobots synced. Let me rebuild this battlefield.
nova.开战: Analyzing threat level. Time to upgrade our approach.
nova.大招: Another successful field test. The data is incredible.
nova.胜利: The nanobots get bored easily. Right now they're building tiny sculptures inside my arm.

cipher.选择: Zero protocol initialized. I am already inside.
cipher.开战: Connection established. Their systems are mine.
cipher.技能: FULL SYSTEM OVERRIDE! Every machine bows to zero!
cipher.入狱: I've been alive in seventeen different simulated realities this morning. Tuesday.

atlas.选择: Iron Wall standing by. Nothing gets past me.
atlas.技能: IRON FORTRESS MODE! Attack me! ALL OF YOU!
atlas.大招: Armor holding. I've had worse from training dummies.

aurora.选择: The light has not faded. I am here to protect.
aurora.开战: May dawn's light guide us through the darkness.
aurora.技能: HEAVENLY JUDGMENT! Let the light of paradise descend!
aurora.大招: I can bear this pain. Others cannot.
aurora.受伤: No one had to die today. That is the true victory.
aurora.胜利: The light... please... don't let it go out... not yet...
aurora.入狱: I tried to understand human fashion once. I still don't get why shoes need heels.

thorin.选择: My hammer thirsts! Point me at the biggest one!
thorin.开战: HAHA! Finally, a fight worth my time!
thorin.技能: HAMMER FALL! Feel the wrath of thunder!
thorin.大招: RAGNAROK UNLEASHED! I BECOME THE STORM ITSELF!
thorin.受伤: HA! That tickled! Give me more!
thorin.胜利: ANOTHER VICTORY FOR THE THUNDER! DRINKS ON ME!
thorin.入狱: The storm... fades... but thunder... echoes... forever...
thorin.闲聊: Last week I accidentally destroyed a vending machine. It looked at me funny. No regrets.

raven.选择: I walk between worlds. Don't follow unless you want to die.
raven.开战: The shadows are hungry tonight. Feed them.
raven.技能: ABYSS GATE OPEN! Every sin you've committed reaches for you!
raven.大招: Hmph. I've felt worse from my own demons.
raven.受伤: Another soul harvested. But not yours... not tonight.
raven.胜利: The shadows... they're calling me home... not this time...
raven.入狱: The demon inside me has opinions about everything. Mostly negative. Currently it hates your shoes.

lilith.选择: Blood and fire, baby. Let me paint the town red.
lilith.开战: Ooh, fresh canvas! Let's make some art with pain.
lilith.技能: Blood roses bloom! Isn't it beautiful, darling?
lilith.大招: GARDEN OF BLOOD! Every petal is a kiss of death!
lilith.胜利: Darling, you should've run when you had the chance.
lilith.入狱: The blood... mine... it's so... cold...
lilith.闲聊: People say I have a dark sense of humor. I say they haven't seen my garden at midnight.

morrigan.选择: I've already seen how this ends. Let me show you.
morrigan.开战: The threads are clear. Your fate is... complicated.
morrigan.技能: Your strings are mine to pull now.
morrigan.大招: FINAL THREAD SEVERED! Destiny ends HERE!
morrigan.胜利: The threads weave victory. As I always knew they would.
morrigan.入狱: Even my sight... cannot see beyond... this ending...

hollow.选择: Death refused me. So I command it instead.
hollow.开战: Rise, my servants. We have an appointment with the living.
hollow.大招: UNDEAD SCOURGE! Every corpse in this city is MY soldier!
hollow.受伤: Pain is just a memory. I don't have those anymore.
hollow.胜利: The dead have spoken. They say we won.
hollow.入狱: Finally... true rest... after all these... centuries...
hollow.闲聊: The ghosts around me are complaining about the wifi signal again. Even in death, no peace.

fang.选择: Twelve predators. One hunter. Let's go.
fang.开战: I can smell your fear. Delicious.
fang.技能: BEAST FORM! Claws out, fangs down!
fang.大招: FULL APEX PREDATOR! Twelve genes become ONE!
fang.受伤: RAAGH! That just made me angry!
fang.胜利: The hunt is over. I always catch my prey.
fang.入狱: The beast within... it's taking over... no... not again...
fang.闲聊: On a scale of one to ten, my urge to howl at the moon right now is an eleven.

spore.选择: The mycelium network is listening. And so am I.
spore.开战: Shall we see what grows from this battlefield?
spore.技能: Spore cloud deployed. Breathe deep... or don't.
spore.大招: FUNGAL DOMINION! Let nature reclaim everything!
spore.入狱: The mycelium... goes silent... the forest... forgets me...

psyche.选择: I already know what you're thinking. Don't bother.
psyche.开战: Your mind is an open book. Let me rewrite it.
psyche.技能: PSYCHIC STORM! Get out of my head!
psyche.大招: ABYSS OF MIND! Face your deepest terror!
psyche.受伤: That... was loud. My head is louder now.
psyche.胜利: Too many voices... can't... find mine... anymore...
psyche.入狱: Everyone around here is thinking about lunch. Except Titan. He's thinking about punching things.

orion.选择: Stars guide my path. I will not be lost again.
orion.开战: By the light of a thousand suns, we fight.
orion.技能: STAR RIVER CASCADE! The cosmos fights alongside us!
orion.大招: A star does not dim from a single blow.
orion.受伤: The constellations align in victory. Home feels closer now.
orion.胜利: My light... fading... but the stars... remember...
orion.入狱: Earth gravity is so heavy. On my world we just... float. I miss floating sometimes.

vega.选择: I weave light itself. Try to keep up.
vega.开战: A new design requires new materials. You'll do.
vega.技能: LIGHT WEAVE COMPLETE! You're trapped in my masterpiece!
vega.大招: My form flickers... how dare you damage the design!
vega.受伤: Perfection achieved. As always. You're welcome.
vega.胜利: The light... dims... my masterpiece... unfinished...
vega.入狱: I redesigned three combat suits this morning. The fourth one can literally walk through walls. Fashion.

blaze.选择: My fists don't negotiate. Let's talk with knuckles.
blaze.开战: Twelve rounds. I won't need more than one.
blaze.技能: ONE PUNCH. ONE WORLD. ONE ME!
blaze.受伤: And the crowd goes WILD! That's championship form!
blaze.入狱: I bench-press trucks for fun. The gym banned me after the third incident. Understandable.

shadow.选择: You won't see me. You won't hear me. You'll just... lose.
shadow.大招: SHADOW REALM DESCENDS. Welcome to my world.
shadow.闲聊: ...No, I won't show you my face. ...No, I don't eat in front of people. ...Yes, I'm annoyed.

titan.选择: I don't need powers. I AM the power.
titan.开战: Everyone stay back. This one's mine.
titan.技能: GROUND POUND! Feel the earth SHAKE!
titan.大招: ABSOLUTE DOMAIN! NOTHING. MOVES. BUT ME!
titan.受伤: I didn't feel that. I never feel anything.
titan.胜利: Still standing. As always. As I always will.
titan.闲聊: Doctors say I should feel pain. I tried once. Overrated. Recommend the numbness instead.
